thesis: Ellen Ellison invested in Rashmi Kwatra's 16th Street Capital because she observed the manager's deep knowledge of her portfolio companies and her ability to earn respect from management teams during a due diligence trip to Manila. Ellison also valued Kwatra's openness to simplifying fund terms and her long-term runway as a young, concentrated manager focused on emerging markets in South and Southeast Asia.
